title: Complaints on Lapses in Real-time Updates for MRT Breakdowns
what_it_is: Complaints on Lapses in Real-time Updates for MRT Breakdowns

sections.label: North-South Line radio communication loss
sections.summary: On 28 June at 4.52 pm, North-South Line trains lost radio communication with the trackside signalling system and halted suddenly.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: On 28 June at 4.52 pm, North-South Line trains lost radio communication with the trackside signalling system and came to a sudden halt.

sections.label: Thales human error fault
sections.summary: The 28 June fault was due to human error by a Thales team installing radio devices for the East-West Line re-signalling project, and was cleared by isolating the East-West Line radio network.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The fault on 28 June was due to human error by a Thales engineering team installing radio devices for the East-West Line re-signalling project.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The error was realised almost immediately and the fault was cleared by isolating the East-West Line radio network from the North-South Line.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: Normal North-South Line services were progressively restored by 6.45 pm.

sections.label: SMRT additional staff deployment
sections.summary: During the incident, SMRT deployed 500 additional staff to affected North-South Line stations to manage crowds, assist and inform commuters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: During the incident, SMRT deployed 500 additional staff to affected North-South Line stations to manage crowds, render assistance and disseminate information to commuters.

sections.label: LTA monitors disruptions, holds operators accountable
sections.summary: LTA monitors all disruptions closely and holds rail operators accountable for lapses in providing timely and accurate information to commuters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: The Land Transport Authority (LTA) monitors all disruptions closely and holds rail operators accountable for any lapses in providing timely and accurate information to commuters.

sections.label: North-South Line re-signalling final phase
sections.summary: For the North-South Line re-signalling project, the speaker thinks they are already entering the last leg, the last phase of testing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: Fortunately, for the re-signalling project for North-South Line, I think we are already entering the last leg, the last phase of testing.

sections.label: North-South Line re-signalling delays decline
sections.summary: North-South Line delays due to re-signalling peaked at about 20, declined to six last month, and the speaker is pushing for completion before December.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: For the North-South Line, the number of delays due to re-signalling peaked at about 20.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: It has since declined to only six last month and continues to decline.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: I am fairly confident that the original timeline to complete the re-signalling of the North-South Line before year end could even be earlier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: I am pushing them to get it out before December, meaning within the next few weeks.

sections.label: East-West Line re-signalling completion
sections.summary: Completing the work by end of November would be an achievement, but full-scale re-signalling for the East-West Line has not yet started.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: If we can complete it by the end of November, it would be quite an achievement.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: But do remember, for the East-West Line, we have yet to start full-scale re-signalling.

sections.label: MKBF target raised to 1,000,000 km
sections.summary: The MKBF target was set at 800,000 km within four years, split into yearly targets, and is now raised to 1,000,000 km.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: So, it was perhaps even reckless on my part to say, "Let us close the gap with Taipei".

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: And, therefore, I set the MKBF target of 800,000 km within four years.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: But for a long time, we could not even cross 200,000 km.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: I had split the 800,000 km target into: (a) target for this year, 300,000 km, (b) next year, 400,000 km, (c) in 2019 and 2020, 800,000 km.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: In fact, we are almost 400,000 km, which is the target for next year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: That is why I was confident enough to say, let me now raise the target from 800,000 km to 1,000,000 MKBF.

sections.label: North-South Line completion before December
sections.summary: The North-South Line work will be completed before December.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The North-South Line, I have explained to Members that we will complete it before December.
